items.title: Jockey by TwelveLabs
items.source_text: Jockey by TwelveLabs Your entire video library: organized, searchable, understood Jockey is the first AI that understands your entire media library across photos and video. It analyzes thousands of hours of footage so you can find and connect people, moments and context across videos. Use it in Claude or ChatGPT, or build with the API/SDK. Ingest YouTube, TikTok and Instagram Reels links; assemble content into MP4s; and create and share video-driven artifacts with playable clips. Every TwelveLabs model upgrade makes Jockey better, without re-integration. Productivity Artificial Intelligence Video

items.title: Harness by Autonomous
items.source_text: Harness by Autonomous Every coding agent, every machine, one command center. Harness is the open-source command center for coding agents. Claude Code at work, Codex at home, Hermes in the cloud: every agent on every machine, side by side. Use the native desktop app, hn in your terminal, or the iOS and Android app to answer agents by voice. End-to-end encrypted. Then go beyond code with 49 harnesses for CAD, circuits, robots, games and music. Free on Mac and Linux. Open Source Developer Tools Artificial Intelligence GitHub

items.source_text: SignWith E-signatures without the subscription. Pay per doc. Sign 3 documents free every month, then buy one-time credit packs from $9.
